title: Many to Many aur Pivot Data
objectives: `belongsToMany` aur pivot table ka rishta samajhna
Pivot table ke extra columns (`withPivot`) padhna
prerequisites: One to One aur One to Many (m08-l01)

sections.heading: Many to Many kya hai?
sections.body: Ek order mein kai products ho sakte hain, aur ek product kai orders mein. Dono tables ke beech ek **pivot table** hoti hai (`order_product`). Dono models mein `belongsToMany` likhte hain. Pivot table ka naam dono models ke naam alphabetical order mein, singular: `order_product`.
explain: Eloquent pivot table ka naam `order_product` aur keys `order_id`, `product_id` khud guess karta hai.
`withPivot('quantity', 'price')` – pivot ke extra columns ko `pivot` object mein laata hai.
`withTimestamps()` – pivot ke `created_at`/`updated_at` automatically bharta hai (pivot mein ye columns chahiye).

sections.heading: Real-world example: Order mein products jodna
sections.body: `attach`, `detach`, `sync` aur `toggle` pivot rows ko manage karte hain:
explain: `sync([...])` – exactly di hui ids hi rahengi. Form ke checkboxes (jaise tags) ke liye perfect.

callout.text: `sync` ke saath pivot data dena ho to: `sync([5 => ['quantity' => 2], 6 => ['quantity' => 1]])`.

sections.heading: Pivot data padhna aur filter karna
sections.body: Har related model par `pivot` property milti hai:
explain: `$product->pivot->quantity` – tabhi milega jab relationship mein `withPivot('quantity')` likha ho.

versionDiff.heading: Many to many: Laravel 11, 12 aur 13
versionDiff.intro: `belongsToMany` aur `attach`/`sync` teeno versions mein same hain.

items.13: Same as 11. Custom pivot model (`using(...)`) bhi supported hai.

errors.error: SQLSTATE: Base table or view not found: Table 'order_products' doesn't exist
errors.cause: Pivot table ka naam convention (`order_product`) se alag hai.
errors.fix: Table ka naam alphabetical singular rakho, ya `belongsToMany(Product::class, 'order_products')` mein naam do.

errors.error: Pivot ke extra column (quantity) null / undefined aa raha hai
SQLSTATE[23000]: Integrity constraint violation (duplicate entry) on attach
errors.cause: Wahi product dobara attach kiya jab composite primary key hai.

debug.body: Pivot table mein asli rows `db:table` ya Tinker se dekho.

code.code:
php artisan db:table order_product
php artisan tinker
>>> App\Models\Order::find(1)->products

tasks: Tinker mein `attach` se 2 products jodo aur `sync` se ek hatao
Order ka total `pivot->quantity * pivot->price` se nikalo

quiz.why: Dono tables ke beech pivot table chahiye.

options: Sirf 1 aur 2 jodta hai, baaki rehte hain
Exactly 1 aur 2 rakhta hai, baaki hata deta hai
quiz.why: `sync` di hui ids hi rakhta hai.

quiz.q: Pivot ke extra column padhne ke liye relationship mein kya likhna padta hai?
quiz.why: `withPivot('col')` se column `pivot` object mein aata hai.

interview.a: Many-to-many relation ke liye beech ki table jisme dono tables ke foreign keys (aur kabhi extra data) hote hain.
`attach` jodta hai, `detach` hatata hai, `sync` poora set di hui ids ke barabar kar deta hai.

interview.q: Pivot table ka default naam kaise guess hota hai?
interview.a: Do model naam alphabetical order mein, singular, underscore se jude: `order_product`.

interview.q: Pivot ke extra columns kaise access karte hain?

interview.a: On/off jaisa selection, jaise product ko wishlist mein jodna ya hatana.

summary: Many-to-many ke liye pivot table (`a_b` alphabetical, singular).
Extra pivot columns ke liye `withPivot()` aur `->pivot`.
